error_model: Prefix world-x Gaussian random walk, first pose fixed, normalized to prefix RMS. One exact correction of all eight historical poses after observation eight; subsequent observations use exact supplied poses. No rotations, estimated uncertainty or object motion.
annotation_policy: Select up to four identifiable static object instances from the four raw reference RGB-D views, prioritizing cross-view identity and excluding wall/floor/ceiling. Record every visible selected instance in all reference views. Polygons, instance IDs, class queries and exclusions must be frozen before SAM/CLIP and mapper outputs are inspected. AI-assisted labels require independent human audit and do not constitute official Replica GT.
coordinate_control: Rebuild corrected geometry using the complete native add/merge/denoise/filter event trace while forcing all historical association and postprocess membership decisions; retain original fused semantic features. This is a strong oracle geometry control, not a deployable low-memory method. Never infer irrecoverable association loss from a single rigid centroid shift.
primary_comparison: Immediately after correction, compare fixed-association corrected geometry with native full replay at the same exact poses and frozen frontend. Use identity support/contamination, partial-surface coverage and restricted top-1 retrieval separately. Continue four and eight observations to measure persistence.
decision_rule: A loss attributable to historical decisions requires oracle replay to improve independently annotated target recovery/identity or restricted query correctness over fixed-association geometry in at least two of three seeds at an RMS level, with no zero-error adapter mismatch. Smaller coordinate distance alone is insufficient. If simple guards match recovery, scope is narrowed; no benefit means do not implement H1 yet. One new scene and seeded interventions do not establish generalization or a common four-method bottleneck.
freeze_gate: No native mapping until the annotation file and source RGB-D manifest hashes are bound in a second immutable freeze record. Later code repairs are logged, not silently substituted for frozen inputs.
